matching_pages_notes: Original PDF pages 191-200 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 460 printed rows were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed name and initials, rank, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. All ten pages matched the extraction and no correction was needed. Repeated or near-matching rows remain distinct, including Palmer L Hansen; Edward W Harding; Simon C Harrington; James D Hart; Donald J Haselfeld/Haselfield; Vivian F/Vivian King Haymaker; William F Hazalwood/Hazelwood; Marjorie Hazard/Hazzard; and James E Healey/Healy. The review also preserves the cross-page Harrington private-identifier collision without publishing the identifier, the unfamiliar printed rank 0 for Thomas F Harris, the literal [fnu] Hastings entry, truncated printed forms, foreign and service notes, and out-of-sequence box values. Private identifiers are not included in this bundle or public assets.
